summary: Validated mandatory E.164 phone across all signup/activation paths. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (needs_phone flag for superadmin/admin w/wo phone, /auth/complete-profile accepts valid E.164 and persists, rejects empty/invalid/non-E164, requires auth, does not change org/role; invite /register without phone -> 400, with phone -> 200 and user has E.164). Frontend: QA admin without phone is gated to /completa-profilo, UI shows 'Completa il tuo profilo' with IT (+39) default country and complete-profile-tel/submit testids; after entering a valid number the user is redirected to /app; subsequent /app visits don't re-gate; superadmin is never gated.
critical_code_review_comments: CompleteProfile.jsx: data-testid='complete-profile-tel' is applied on react-phone-number-input container which does not propagate to the inner <input>. The inner tel input lacks a direct data-testid. Suggestion: pass numberInputProps={{'data-testid':'complete-profile-tel-input'}} to make the raw input directly selectable by tests. Current workaround used in tests: '.phone-input input'.

Google-on-invite flow could not be exercised end-to-end because Emergent Google OAuth is not automatable; it is covered indirectly by backend contract (needs_phone + /auth/complete-profile) and by the frontend gate verified with the QA account.
